_comment: OPTIONAL metadata sidecar for the offline (no-ADT) folder workflow. Place this file named exactly 'metadata.json' in the SAME folder as your dumped ABAP source files. CodeMetadataIngestor matches entries to source objects by 'name' (case-insensitive) and enriches them with data ADT would normally provide. Everything is optional: a missing file (or missing field) just leaves file-derived defaults. tadirType uses 4-letter TADIR codes (PROG, CLAS, FUGR, INTF, TABL, DDLS, ENHO, ENHS, ...); devClass enables modification detection (SAP package => modification); usageCount=0 marks an unused object => RETIRE (≈0 MD). Produce this with any tool/report (e.g. a SE38 TADIR/SCMON dump).
